description.raw: '''Active:''' '''Singed''' [[File:Airborne icon.png|20px|link=Airborne|An icon representing the keyword Airborne]] [[:Airborne|flings]] the target enemy 550 units over himself over 0.693 seconds, dealing magic damage. The damage based on the target's health ratio is capped at 300 against [[File:Minion icon.png|20px|link=Minion|An icon representing the keyword Minion]] [[:Minion|minions]] and [[File:Monster icon.png|20px|link=Monster|An icon representing the keyword Monster]] [[:Monster|monsters]].
description.text: Active: Singed flings the target enemy 550 units over himself over 0.693 seconds, dealing magic damage. The damage based on the target's health ratio is capped at 300 against minions and monsters.

description2.raw: If the target lands on ''[[File:Singed Mega Adhesive.png|20xpx|border|link=Singed#Mega Adhesive|An icon for Singed's ability Mega Adhesive]] [[Singed#Mega Adhesive|Mega Adhesive's]]'' area of effect after the displacement, they are [[File:Root icon.png|20px|link=Root|An icon representing the keyword Root]] [[:Root|rooted]] for a duration.
description2.text: If the target lands on Mega Adhesive's area of effect after the displacement, they are rooted for a duration.

leveling.raw:
'''Magic Damage:'''
50 / 60 / 70 / 80 / 90 (+ 6 / 6.5 / 7 / 7.5 / 8% of target's '''maximum''' health) (+ 55% AP)
leveling.text: Magic Damage:50 / 60 / 70 / 80 / 90 (+ 6 / 6.5 / 7 / 7.5 / 8% of target's maximum health) (+ 55% AP)

notes.raw: * During ''Fling'' cast time (the windup not during the actual fling) the enemy's flash is already locked, making it a non reactable spell. * ''Fling'' can throw enemies over walls (circumstances permitting). * [[File:Slow immune 2.png|20px|link=Slow_resist#Slow Immunity|An icon representing the keyword Slow-immune]] [[:Slow_resist#Slow Immunity|Slow-immune]] enemies will not be [[File:Root icon.png|20px|link=Root|An icon representing the keyword Root]] [[:Root|rooted]] when ''flung'' into [[File:Singed Mega Adhesive.png|20xpx|border|link=Singed#Mega Adhesive|An icon for Singed's ability Mega Adhesive]] [[Singed#Mega Adhesive|Mega Adhesive]]. * ''Fling'' is special cased to not [[File:Airborne icon.png|20px|link=Airborne|An icon representing the keyword Airborne]] [[:Airborne|fling]] [[File:Warwick OriginalSquare.png|20xpx|border|link=Warwick|An icon representing Warwick]] [[Warwick]] while '''Singed''' is [[File:Suppression icon.png|20px|link=Types of Crowd Control#Suppression|An icon representing the keyword Suppression]] [[:Types of Crowd Control#Suppression|suppressed]] by [[File:Warwick Infinite Duress.png|20xpx|border|link=Warwick#Infinite Duress|An icon for Warwick's ability Infinite Duress]] [[Warwick#Infinite Duress|Infinite Duress]] after the cast time. * If the target becomes [[File:Untargetable icon.png|20px|link=Untargetable|An icon representing the keyword Untargetable]] [[:Untargetable|untargetable]], [[File:Death icon.svg|20px|link=Death|An icon representing the keyword Death]] [[:Death|dies]], or is too far away or no longer in [[File:Sight icon.png|20px|link=Sight|An icon representing the keyword Sight]] [[:Sight|sight]] during the cast time, this ability will cancel but does not go on [[File:Cooldown icon.png|15px|link=Cooldown]] cooldown nor pay its cost (if applicable).
notes.text:
During Fling cast time (the windup not during the actual fling) the enemy's flash is already locked, making it a non reactable spell.
Fling can throw enemies over walls (circumstances permitting).
Slow-immune enemies will not be rooted when flung into Mega Adhesive.
Fling is special cased to not fling Warwick while Singed is suppressed by Infinite Duress after the cast time.
If the target becomes untargetable, dies, or is too far away or no longer in sight during the cast time, this ability will cancel but does not go on  cooldown nor pay its cost (if applicable).
